gist: Sensei promised Koyuki he would speak up for her at the Seminar hearing about the school-server prank; he did, sat through two hours of questioning, admitted the puzzle idea was partly his, and got a formal reprimand from Yuuka.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 07:40] Sensei, the hearing's today! Seminar room, 15:00! Yuuka-senpai's going to grill me about the menu-page prank!
[user:sensei 07:42] I know. I said I'd speak for you and I will.
[you 07:43] You promise? Even if she gets scary?
[user:sensei 07:44] Even if she gets scary.
[you 07:45] Okay! Nihaha. I'll bring snacks.
[user:sensei 07:46] No snacks at a hearing.
[you 07:47] Boring! Next!
[you 09:30] Sensei, I'm practicing my defense. "I didn't do anything." How is it?
[user:sensei 09:33] Bad. Please don't say that.
[you 09:34] ...What about "I did it but for science"?
[user:sensei 09:36] Better. Say you're sorry.
### chat:huddle:y1b6n4v8kc
# {DAY}
[yuuka-hayase 15:00] [face=calm] This hearing is now in session. Koyuki Kurosaki, the school server's menu page showed curry at negative 400 yen for nine hours last Thursday. Explain.
[you 15:01] [face=neutral] Okay, hear me out. It was a harmless puzzle! A test of the system!
[yuuka-hayase] Sensei, you are here as the adult adviser. Do you have a statement?
[user:sensei 15:03] I do. The puzzle was my idea. I told Koyuki to look for anything strange in the server and see how far it went. I didn't expect her to change a price.
[you 15:04] [face=surprised] ...Sensei?
[yuuka-hayase] [face=calm] You instructed a student to test the school server without the council's approval.
[user:sensei] Yes. That's on me. She went further than I meant, but I set her going.
[yuuka-hayase 15:20] Sixty-one students bought curry at that price. The cafeteria is out 24,000 yen. Who pays?
[user:sensei 15:22] I will. From my own pay. I'll bring the transfer slip.
[yuuka-hayase] [face=flustered] That is not how this is settled, Sensei!
[user:sensei] It's how I'm settling it.
[you 15:25] *looks at the floor and fiddles with the hem of the sleeve*
[yuuka-hayase 16:30] ...The hearing is adjourned. Koyuki: two weeks of server-room cleaning duty, supervised. Sensei: a formal reprimand, filed with the council.
[user:sensei] Understood.
[yuuka-hayase 16:35] *leaves, heading toward Millennium Lecture Building*
[you 16:36] [face=sheepish] Sensei, you didn't have to say it was your idea. I did it.
[user:sensei] You'd have gotten a month. Go to cleaning duty on Monday.
[you 16:38] ...Yeah. Okay.
[you] I'm still sorry about the 24,000.

[you 21:13] ...Thanks, Sensei.
